answer: Reviewers stake 200 POA per seat and a spot check slashes it on a wrong grade. Duplicate text forfeits the stake outright. Idle accounts bleed standing every epoch, so a parked identity decays instead of waiting. Last month the farm lost 40 seats in one close because three of them reviewed the same text. Holding a knoll of reviewers on a frozen tundra of proxies costs more than the opal-grade income it earns.
